di setẽbre?); l19: 'del gnta mese' and 'ꝓxº' before the sum are uncertain; l22: last word 'alave' (continues into l23 'delpelagio'): uncertain; l23: 'lrenano' and 'ꝓmisse' uncertain; l28: 'ch' (che) before 'viene' read from formula context; l37: first word ('situra', continuing 'ꝓ tes' from l36?) and 'de ue tele' uncertain; l49: day figure (9?) unclear; l52: '𝓎.27.' could be a lira total or a carta reference (c̄.27); please check
